subject: Initiating MAP & Evaluation Playbook — EU Data Localization (NordicBank)
messages:
From: Sara Karlsson <sara.karlsson@nordicbank.com>
To: marcus.lin@redwood.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-05T08:12:00Z
Subject: MAP kickoff & initial asks — EU data localization evaluation

Hi Marcus + Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week. NordicBank is ready to move from discovery to a short MAP (mutual action plan) and an evaluation sprint focused on EU data localization and cross-border transfer constraints. Our internal stakeholders are listed below — I'm copying Erik (product) and Anders (our external infra consultant).

High-level goals for the next 6 weeks:
- Validate that Redwood can meet our residency and audit log requirements in both DE and SE jurisdictions.
- Run a POC ingesting a sanitized customer dataset and measure latency/cost under our expected load.
- Produce a formal runbook and MAP with milestone owners to support procurement and legal sign-off.

Can you propose a 60–75 minute kickoff to align on roles, immediate tasks, and acceptance criteria? Ideally early next week (Dec 7–9). I've attached a one-page exec summary and a CSV with our initial list of security contacts.

Attachments: [Attachment: NordicBank-MAP-exec-summary.pdf (pdf, 1 page)], [Attachment: NordicBank-security-stakeholders.csv (csv, 1KB)]

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Karlsson
Head of AI Platforms
NordicBank
Phone: +46 70 555 1212

From: marcus.lin@redwood.com <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Sara Karlsson <sara.karlsson@nordicbank.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-05T12:35:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff & initial asks — EU data localization evaluation

Sara — great to hear and thanks for the clear goals. We're excited to partner on this. Quick intro from my side: I'm Marcus (solutions lead for enterprise MAPs) and Laura (cc'd) will run the evaluation coordination and security touchpoints. I'll propose an initial MAP playbook below and a pair of concrete times; please pick whichever fits.

Proposed kickoff objectives (60–75 min):
1) Confirm stakeholders & roles (owner for each milestone).
2) Review acceptance criteria for residency, audit logging, and KV cache purge policies.
3) Agree on data-handling approach for the POC (sanitization, ephemeral storage, KMS).
4) Map milestones: environment setup, first ingest, perf evaluation, runbook + legal packet.

Suggested immediate milestones (first 4 weeks):
- Week 0: Kickoff & environment access (owner: Redwood / Marcus)
- Week 1: POC environment ready + ingest test (owner: NordicBank / Erik)
- Week 2: Latency/cost runs + kernel/quantization config (owner: Redwood / Laura)
- Week 3: Security evidence collection + draft runbook (owner: NordicBank + Redwood)

Owners and roles (we'll formalize in a shared MAP spreadsheet):
- Redwood: environment provisioning, model variants for POC, perf/cost analysis, runbook template.
- NordicBank: sanitized dataset, security approvals, procurement milestone sign-off.
- EU IT Consulting (Anders): infra connectivity and VPC peering support.

Proposed kickoff slots (Central European Time):
- Tue, 2026-12-07 10:00–11:15 CET
- Wed, 2026-12-08 09:00–10:15 CET
- Wed, 2026-12-08 15:00–16:15 CET

Pre-read I'll upload: Redwood MAP template (attached), an outline of our evaluation checklist, and a short performance expectations note.

Attachments: [Attachment: Redwood-MAP-template.xlsx (xlsx, 3 sheets)]

Next steps: choose a slot and we'll send a calendar invite + shared MAP spreadsheet. Also looping in Soojin from our security team for the kickoff.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Solutions Lead, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0133

Date: 2026-12-06T09:04:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff & initial asks — EU data localization evaluation

Marcus / Sara — a couple of quick notes from security/controls perspective:
- Please ensure our kickoff includes a 15-min slot for evidence and controls mapping (SOC2, audit logs retention, KMS). I'll draft a minimal list of artifacts we'll need from NordicBank and from Redwood.
- Suggest we include Soojin Lee (cc'd) who will coordinate the security checklist and the evidence handoff. Soojin — can you confirm availability for the suggested times and add any must-have evidence items to the shared sheet?

Laura Bennett
